question: How many faces may the Bhairava forms associated with one figure have?
premises: Bhairavas are described in relation to one figure.
They may be four-faced or five-faced.
inference: The associated Bhairava forms may alternatively be depicted with four or five faces.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of ekasyāḥ to bhairavāḥ is somewhat compressed.
plain_english: Or the Bhairavas associated with one of them may be four-faced or five-faced.
